text: {"lessons":["I should not judge a stock only by whether it is above or below my purchase price; average cost does not predict its future return.","I should avoid selling winners just to secure a gain while holding losers to avoid admitting a mistake. I should base both decisions on forward-looking reasons.","Recent price history and a short run of account losses do not reliably predict what comes next, so I should follow a consistent plan rather than react to daily moves."]}
